statement.p: At a recent trip to the casino, Adeline brought {\$860} in cash. She knows she needs to hold on to {\$90} in reserve to pay for dinner later. Unfortunately Adeline had rough luck and was losing money at the slot machines at an average rate of {\$250} per hour. How long was Adeline gambling before she had to stop? Write an equation to model this scenario. There is no need to solve it.
